title: LOOK who just solved the Endurance Bike problem! - The NEW Look 765 Optimum for 2023

takeaways.text: On a size 56: 606 mm stack, mid-range reach and a 70.8° head angle with a low bottom bracket, which he expects to give stable descending without a gravel-bike BB height.
A round 27.2 mm seatpost and T47 threaded bottom bracket keep servicing simple; clearance is 34 mm, while the separate Optimum+ takes 45 mm and 650B wheels.
Cables route internally but pass under the stem with a generous bend radius; frame and fork are claimed at about 1,400 g.
UK pricing at launch: about £3,700 with mechanical Ultegra and £2,100 for the frameset, close to a Domane SL 5 or Roubaix Sport.

disclosure: Launch-day commentary by a UK workshop that had ordered one; the bike was not yet ridden.
summary: A UK workshop's launch analysis of the 2023 LOOK 765 Optimum endurance road bike geometry, standards and pricing.
